reviews.comment: Capt Nelick is one of the best professors at TAMUG. He does a flipped style classroom, and if you stay for his Q&As you will learn a lot. He cares a lot about the students who actually want to be there and learn. Professionalism is important to him, so show up on time and do not curse. Do the work, ask questions, watch the lectures, you'll be fine
Very easy class. I got a B becuse my professionalism grade was horrible (he does not like cussing). Who wouldn't like being taught by one of the eight Master Mariners in the world

Captain Nelilk is one of the best professors at TAMUG. He tells you exactly what is on the test. He makes his lectures interesting and relevant to things we need to know. Also, he was a chief engineer, captain, and naval officer. However, if you are late or absent, he will fail you or take points off your final grade for professionalism.

Captain Nelick is a great professor who welcomes any and all questions during his lectures. He often ends class early, while still covering lots of information. He is clear about what he will expect on tests. Make sure you stay awake, off your phone, & ask questions. If you put in the effort, your grade will reflect it.

I really enjoyed taking his class. He made everything very clear. He welcomed all questions, and if he wasn't sure he would get back to you by the next class after doing some digging. He does not tolerate anyone falling asleep in class. He always starts class with, "It is 9:10, which is when you stop talking and I start talking," or what time it is
